entities.summary: The Christuskirche is a Lutheran Evangelical church in Rome. It was built between 1910 and 1922 under direction of architect Franz Heinrich Schwechten, who also responsible for the Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtniskirche in Berlin. Christuskirche is a church building in Europe, established in 1922. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
